description.text: Beginning Set DX Pikachu ver., released on 18 November 2011 in time for Christmas: the cards of the Black & White Beginning Set, three ready-built 30-card half decks, with Pikachu extras, a special holo Pikachu found in no other product and a trunk case, deck case, damage counter case, A5 clear file and stickers with Pikachu designs. A playmat, a coin, damage counters and markers, the how-to-play DVD and a rule book completed it. Its cards carry this set's own code, HSP, rather than the Beginning Set's HS.
